name: Nextcloud
tagline: Your personal cloud — files, calendar, contacts, more
description: Self-hosted productivity platform: file sync & share, calendars, contacts, office suite hooks. The classic self-hosted Google Drive replacement.
compose:
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:apache
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.data_dir}}:/var/www/html/data
    restart: unless-stopped
